# Review routing

Add an area with one table row and one guide file. `*` applies to every PR; every other
prefix ends in `/` and matches at a directory boundary. A path can route more than one guide.

| Changed path prefix | Guide |
| --- | --- |
| * | docs/CrossCuttingGuidance.md |
| src/Components/ | docs/BlazorComponentsGuidance.md |
